# Assets

This directory is for runtime assets that are **not** vendored in the
repository but which the application optionally loads from disk.

## BSCAN SPI bridge bitstreams (required for flash programming)

Writing an SPI configuration ROM over JTAG uses a small helper bitstream that
exposes the PL's SPI master through the BSCAN `USER1` instruction.  We do
**not** ship this bitstream — it is generated by a third-party project under
its own license.

* Project : <https://github.com/quartiq/bscan_spi_bitstreams>
* License : MIT (see upstream)
* For PYNQ-Z1/Z2 (XC7Z020) download: `bscan_spi_xc7z020.bit`

Place the downloaded `.bit` file anywhere on disk; the GUI and the
`flash_program` CLI accept an explicit path each run.

## Generating the `.bin` flash image

From a Vivado project that implements your target design:

```tcl
write_cfgmem -force -format BIN -interface SPIx1 -size 16 \
             -loadbit "up 0x00000000 <your_design>.bit" \
             <your_design>.bin
```

`-size 16` corresponds to a 16-Mbyte flash (MT25QL128).  The produced
`<your_design>.bin` is what `flash_program --bin ...` and the GUI
"Tools → Program Flash (SPI ROM)..." menu expect.
